A clean engine archive rebuilds the packaged shell without any family checkout, preserving its sealed delivery bytes.

Tree cards answer who this is with given name, clan surname, known life years and birthplace; relationships, confidence and patronymics belong to the full card. The full card retains documentary spellings and explains a surname supplied from children.
Reader preview exposes permission-filtered review material without a generation or publication authority.
Display export and consumption ignore unreferenced record/search edits; adopted input errors and changes still block, including references from saved versions.
The local server verifies a generation and shell once, pins their bytes, and refuses requests after input metadata changes; stable URLs revalidate their ETags.
Local source links preserve the accumulated document subjects; neither reader mode restores a withheld document through a second route.

An explicit local host-private reader retains living narrative details, excludes their documents and structured addresses, labels every HTML screen through language-pack strings, and cannot pass ordinary publication or clean release.
Every distributed reader shell and generated desk carries its engine licence and complete runtime and font notices sealed in the shell manifest.

FEATURE_READER_EXPORT.INVARIANT: Reader delivery preserves the canonical merged person's imported names and qualified claims instead of restoring a pre-merge snapshot.
Retired facts remain visibly retired with their explanation; public card explanations are withheld for people not known dead.
Publication media checks collect every failing reachable file with its URL and reason before blocking delivery.
Only declared asset references are copied as media; full names remain reader text.
Reader cards preserve unnamed relatives, death causes and family spelling variants; testimony and derived facts or unions remain distinct with their evidence status and permitted basis.
Paper provenance, nested literal fields, every selected fragment and local full-document navigation survive reader delivery; generated intake notices use the family language.
Document pages show the preserved title, local return navigation and the family-level fiction notice in the reader language.

FEATURE_FAMILY_DESK.INVARIANT: The owner issues personal logins on Access, with a tree person, role and optional email; the temporary password is shown once. Readers cannot retrieve the page or API.
Only the explicit sign-in action starts state/PKCE; anonymous resource redirects leave an in-flight login untouched. Person IDs remain in signed JSON without HTTP-header character restrictions.

Opt-in Cognito personal publication authenticates every cache hit with a signed expiring cookie and a revocable identity version; reader roles cannot retrieve owner research or other people's feedback. Local and default shared desks retain their behavior.
Reader and supplemental desk screens share one page-top component and control slots; work volume omits zero values.
One shared lower frame serves every desk screen; remarks open on first click without scrolling, never on hover, and dismiss into visible retained drafts. Alternative outcomes accompany work volume.
Interface changes require an executed action/expected/observed browser walk at desktop and phone widths, following method/interface-walk.md; screenshots alone are insufficient.
The investigation derives ordered dateless pages, all recorded alternatives including ruled-out ones, weight shifts and cumulative coverage from research inputs; it is never a research source.
Every desk screen offers one feedback sender with literal text, stable page/person/feed/step context and a human where line; naming, additions, corrections and answers use the same inbox.
Browser-owned receipts show sent, read or addressed and an explicit reader reply; local marks appear immediately and hosted marks enter the next build. Closed drafts survive.
Every desk HTML labels its private version and engine before JavaScript in the same lower row as navigation and feedback; phone controls do not overlap.
Desk rebuilds retain literal person placeholders and withhold source assets after privacy changes; revoking the host decision prevents another build.
Warm builds and shell or language changes reuse a checked reader; cached media remain bound to its seal and person edits affect only their dependent projections.
Journal dates use family month names and the compact single-row navigation retains corrections and relative feedback.
FEATURE_FAMILY_DESK.INTENT: A narrator privately follows their family and sends literal corrections locally, with optional AWS publication.
FEATURE_FAMILY_DESK.INVARIANT: Without publication settings or AWS credentials a desk builds and answers on loopback; cloud commands refuse before subprocess, network or disk mutation.
Only none (default) and explicit aws select publication; local build/serve ignore that section, and incomplete cloud state gives a recovery step without exposing coordinates or credentials.
A desk cannot deliver a family's accepted personal dataset without the recorded host decision for its narrator.
The desk contains only reader delivery, declared narrator pages and trusted desk assets; input files and secrets are absent.

Local desks pin the checked build, cheaply guard its metadata and reverify a changed build record; both local servers use persistent conditional HTTP and same-origin localhost aliases. Consecutive local feedback has no cooldown.
Shared login publishes no correspondence or navigation and neither returns its feedback nor accepts its marks; local origin is explicit.
